title: Inconsistent slice syntax in export_context
description:
File: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/kdf.rs
Lines: 113, 118, 123, 127

Inconsistent slice usage when copying from Vec to array:
- Line 113: `prk_out.copy_from_slice(&prk_out_vec[0..32]);` - explicit range
- Line 118: `prk_exporter.copy_from_slice(&prk_exporter_vec);` - implicit full slice
- Line 123: `master_secret.copy_from_slice(&master_secret_vec);` - implicit
- Line 127: `master_salt.copy_from_slice(&master_salt_vec);` - implicit

The explicit [0..32] on line 113 is defensive but the others rely on Vec length matching array size exactly.

Fix: Use consistent style throughout. Either all explicit ranges or all implicit slices. Implicit is fine since edhoc_kdf guarantees Vec length equals requested length.
